offer.prototype_role: Private search implementation track inside the Proof-to-Market Sprint

audience.primary: Authorized founder or growth/brand lead at an already-selling supplement, recovery, or performance brand facing a live translation decision
audience.secondary: Product, science, evidence, ecommerce, or creative lead who must make the chosen message executable and reviewable

rules: no ranking, citation, traffic, lead, or revenue guarantee

allowed_sources: Current Angle Map and Proof-to-Market canon
Current audience, voice, and proof library
Client-approved product, claim, customer, and reviewer records
Dated local search and analytics exports
Official Google, Bing, OpenAI, FDA, FTC, LinkedIn, IndexNow, and Schema.org documentation
Captured creator transcripts when labeled as practitioner evidence
prohibited_sources: Competitor copy treated as factual authority
Anonymous claims without a dated receipt
Creator advice presented as causal outcome proof
Search-volume or citation estimates without a source
source_policy.corroboration_rule: State whether corroboration means recurrence across captured corpus items or alignment with a separately named authoritative source. Creator recurrence is not independent validation or causation.

allowed: Message differentiation grounded in client-approved product truth
requires_review: Health-benefit, safety, efficacy, or structure/function language
Finished-product claims derived from ingredient research
Schema values describing a real product or reviewer
prohibited: Disease-treatment or prevention claims without the required qualified process
Invented product facts, credentials, sources, or customer language
Guaranteed rankings, citations, traffic, leads, conversions, or revenue
Bulk AI content created mainly to manipulate rankings

patterns: Generic AEO packages lead with platform novelty before resolving the brand message.
Bulk-content offers optimize article count while information gain and claim review stay implicit.
Prior local Source-to-Search materials already cover trust-layer mechanics and must be extended, not relaunched as a competing offer.
The strongest local fit is one approved angle transformed into one inspectable answer asset.

decisions: Search implementation follows an accepted message decision.
